How to Play

Word Search

Look for each word from the list.
Words go across, down or diagonally. Never backwards.
Circle it in the grid and cross it off.
This box is missing a 7.

Easy Sudoku

Every row, column and 3×3 box must have the numbers 1 to 9.
No number repeats in a row, column or box.
Each puzzle has only one solution.

Mazes

Start at the arrow on the left.
Find the one path to the arrow on the right.
Use a pencil so you can try again.
Take your time. Stuck? Solutions start on page 74.

Helpful Tips
A few friendly ideas to get you started.

Word Search

  • Find the first letter of a word, then check the letters all around it.
  • Watch for double letters, like the LL in PILLOW.
  • Go row by row, using your finger or a bookmark as a guide.

Easy Sudoku

  • Start with the row, column or box that already has the most numbers.
  • Pick one number, like 1, and find where it is still missing in each box.
  • Not sure yet? Write small notes in the corner of the square.

Mazes

  • Trace lightly with a pencil so you can erase and try again.
  • Stuck? Start from the exit arrow and work your way back.
  • A dead end is part of the fun. Just go back to the last turn.
No timers, no pressure. One puzzle at a time.
